descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在芝加哥做的纸菜单，高饼边上连着一条短短的纸奶酪线。
descriptions.en: My Chicago paper menu has a short paper cheese thread beside the high crust.

names.zh-Hans: 意式牛肉三明治小菜单

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过牛肉三明治后做的菜单，盘底留着那一小滴肉汁的圆点。
descriptions.en: My menu after Italian beef keeps a little dot for the jus caught on the plate.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 离开耳语展厅后自制的小纸签，凹折只记自己的问候，不是声学模型。
descriptions.en: My paper tab after the Whispering Gallery folds around a personal greeting rather than an acoustic model.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使把河边多迈的半步折成纸脚印，两只纸鞋没有排得很齐。
descriptions.en: My paper footprint from the river walk leaves two paper shoes half a step out of line.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在芝加哥自制的纸包卡，底下露着一只可收回去的纸袜子。
descriptions.en: My homemade Chicago mailbag card has a paper sock that tucks back inside.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 轻声问候后做的纸翻页，打开能看见我攥歪的那道纸包带褶子。
descriptions.en: My flap card after the quiet greeting opens on the crooked crease in a paper strap.
